title: iridodictyum kolpakowskianum
intro: Iridodictyum kolpakowskianum, commonly known as Golden Samambaia, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Polypodiaceae. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include the ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. Therapeutically, Golden Samambaia has been used to treat various conditions such as fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues due to its spasmolytic and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Golden Samambaia include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its use in traditional medicine.
